svg.title: PixelProof — Chrome extension · AI image detection
svg.desc: Feature No. 01: PixelProof — Chrome extension · AI image detection. Status: built, for Next Byte Hacks V2. Is this image real? A Chrome extension that answers while you browse. Flags AI-generated and manipulated images on any page, explains the verdict in plain English and cross-checks the claim against live fact-check data. Fig. 3, how a scan works: 1. Detect — Reality Defender API; 2. Explain — Google Gemini, in plain English; 3. Cross-check — Google Fact Check API. Stack: Chrome MV3, Vanilla JS, Gemini, Reality Defender, Fact Check API. Link: pixelproof.dualmindlab.tech.
